name: pressure_block
source: Uniaxial compression: resultant = p*A = 2 MPa * 400 mm^2 = 800 N, sigma_z = -p, eps = p/E = 5.714e-4. Pressure spreads by real tributary face area (surface_area_per_node) — a different code path than force_n.
notes: Pressure acts against the outward normal of face +z → compression. Interior stress is uniform; boundary layers at support/loaded face same as tension_bar.
